topics.topic_name: Trust, proof, and digital signatures for claims
topics.justification: Top terms like "trust", "sign", "signature", "verify", and "prove" point to using signatures as evidence to validate claims/content (often with real-world/legal framing such as "legal", "document", "screenshot").

topics.topic_name: Network monitoring, VPNs, and traffic/content blocking
topics.justification: Words such as "vpn", "traffic", "isp", "provider", "server", and "block" indicate discussion of who can observe or restrict network activity (e.g., streaming/downloads and institutional settings like "student"/"exam").

topics.topic_name: Web PKI and certificate trust (browser/CA/vendor risk)
topics.justification: "certificate", "browser", "site", "domain", "vendor", and "government" reflect trust in the HTTPS certificate ecosystem and threats like mis-issuance or interception ("attack", "request", "log").

topics.topic_name: Key management and file/data encryption workflows
topics.justification: Heavy weight on "key" plus "encrypt/decrypt", "public_key/private_key", "generate", "store", and "file/document" suggests practical questions about encrypting data and handling keys securely.

topics.topic_name: Security cost, lifecycle, and platform/vendor support decisions
topics.justification: Terms like "company", "cost", "year", "support", "hardware/device", and "standard" point to real-world tradeoffs in maintaining secure systems over time and relying on vendor/platform support.

topics.topic_name: Government backdoors, lawful access, and privacy debate
topics.justification: "government", "backdoor", "law", "privacy", "criminal", and "country" indicate discussion of mandated access to encrypted systems and the societal/security risks of backdoors.

topics.topic_name: Covert communication: steganography and hidden messages
topics.justification: "hide", "steganography", "image/photo", "message", and "ciphertext" align with techniques for concealing communications (often contrasted with normal "encrypt" and mediums like "email"/"text").

topics.topic_name: Encryption software licensing, patents, and export controls
topics.justification: The mix of "license", "open_source", "source_code", "patent", "export", "law", and "country" signals legal/distribution concerns around shipping cryptography in products/apps.
"phone", "device", "network", "internet", "protocol", "connection", and "encrypt" suggest protecting data on mobile/IoT-like endpoints and across network communications against "attacker" access.

topics.topic_name: Cryptographic strength and attacks (including post-quantum concerns)
topics.justification: "algorithm", "break", "attack", "secure", "design", and "quantum" indicate evaluation of algorithm security, threat models, and the impact of quantum adversaries.

topics.topic_name: Payment and credit card data handling security
topics.justification: "card", "credit_card_number", "transaction", "bank", "customer", "payment", and "store" clearly map to securing payment flows and storage/validation of sensitive card/account data.

topics.topic_name: Password storage: hashing, salting, and attacker resistance
topics.justification: "password", "hash", "salt", "database", "store", and "attacker" strongly indicate best practices and threat considerations for securely storing and verifying user passwords.
